policy: kill first; SPAN_UNDERIVED candidates are ineligible (R377 evidence-derivation requirement); R397 Phase 2: DOES_NOT_BEAT_BASELINE and PLAUSIBILITY_BOUND_VIOLATED candidates are ineligible for release (the machine's own physics gates the claim); among survivors prefer better E15-B verdict, then BEATS_BASELINE, then fewer deficient areas, then fewer UNCERTAIN attack outcomes; NO numeric score is computed (CEO standing rule: no new scoring systems)

ranked.mechanism: Integrated radial hybrid magnetic bearing providing contactless suspension via magnetic force fields to eliminate mechanical friction and thermal coupling.
ranked.intervention: Replace the reaction wheel's mechanical contact bearings with an integrated radial hybrid magnetic bearing system, utilizing active magnetic field control to decouple the rotor from the housing and prevent stall due to low-temperature lubricant viscosity changes.

ranked.mechanism: Integrated radial hybrid magnetic bearing providing contactless rotor support
ranked.intervention: Command the reaction wheel motor to operate in a magnetic suspension mode using the integrated radial hybrid magnetic bearing, eliminating mechanical bearing contact during eclipse thermal transients.

ranked.mechanism: Lubricant viscosity-temperature coupling causes transient high-friction state; shadow-induced thermal contraction reduces bearing clearance, increasing radial load and friction torque above available actuation torque, resulting in stall.
ranked.intervention: Pre-coat bearing with low-temperature stable synthetic oil and implement active thermal compensation via localized heaters to maintain operating temperature range.
